records.title_en: Attachments support action descriptions, not exercise rankings
records.title_zh: 起止点能解释动作，不能直接给动作排名
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 肌肉从哪里起、附着到哪里、跨过哪些关节，可以帮助解释它可能产生的动作。但这些结构信息不能直接证明某个动作激活最高、最安全或最适合增肌。
records.technical_summary_en: Origin, insertion and joint crossing support plausible action descriptions but do not quantify exercise contribution.
records.limitations: Task, joint position, external load, technique and individual anatomy still affect contribution.

records.title_en: Muscle roles depend on the task
records.title_zh: 肌肉角色会随任务改变
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 同一块肌肉在一个动作里可能主要产生运动，在另一个动作里主要稳定关节。SportRX 因此不会把原动肌、协同肌和稳定肌标签换算成固定的有效组数。
records.technical_summary_en: Mover and stabilizer roles are task-dependent and cannot be converted into fixed hypertrophy credit.
records.limitations: Role labels simplify coordination and do not replace biomechanical or physiological measurement.

records.title_zh: 跨双关节肌肉必须保留关节位置
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 肱二头肌、肱三头肌长头、股直肌、部分腘绳肌和腓肠肌跨越两个关节。改变其中一个关节的位置会改变肌肉长度与任务条件，但不等于完全隔离或自动获得更大增肌效果。
records.technical_summary_en: Biarticular muscle length and contribution vary with both joint positions.
records.limitations: Anatomy alone does not determine force, activation, hypertrophy or a safe personal setup.

records.title_en: Pectoralis major links the trunk to the humerus
records.title_zh: 胸大肌连接躯干与肱骨
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use for generally healthy adults.
records.summary_zh: 胸大肌从锁骨、胸骨和肋软骨区域连到肱骨，主要参与肩水平内收、内收和内旋。水平推和飞鸟都能表达这些任务，但不能据此证明某个角度是唯一最佳选择。
records.technical_summary_en: Pectoralis major contributes to horizontal adduction, adduction and internal rotation of the shoulder.
records.limitations: Regional fiber contribution and individual hypertrophy are not quantified.

records.title_en: Latissimus dorsi is a shoulder extensor and adductor
records.title_zh: 背阔肌主要参与肩伸展与内收
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use for generally healthy adults.
records.summary_zh: 背阔肌从下胸椎、腰背筋膜、髂嵴和下位肋骨区域连到肱骨，主要参与肩伸展和内收。垂直拉通常更直接表达这些动作，水平拉也可参与。
records.technical_summary_en: Latissimus dorsi crosses the shoulder and contributes to extension, adduction and internal rotation.
records.limitations: Grip and torso-angle claims require exercise-specific evidence beyond anatomy.

records.title_en: Scapular muscles do not perform one single back action
records.title_zh: 肩胛肌群并不是一个单一的背部动作
records.population: Foundational human anatomy; educational use for generally healthy adults.
records.summary_zh: 斜方肌、菱形肌和前锯肌分别参与肩胛上提、后缩、前伸与旋转等任务。划船、耸肩和推举中的作用不同，不能用一个笼统的‘背部激活’标签替代。
records.technical_summary_en: Scapular elevation, retraction, protraction and rotation involve distinct but coordinated muscle roles.
records.limitations: No scapular dyskinesis, posture or pain diagnosis is supported.

records.title_en: The deltoid has three functionally distinct regions
records.title_zh: 三角肌前中后束的主要动作不同
records.population: Foundational shoulder anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 前束主要参与肩屈曲，中束主要参与肩外展，后束主要参与肩水平外展和伸展。肩上推、侧平举与后肩动作因此不能压缩成一个 delts 标签。
records.technical_summary_en: Anterior, lateral and posterior deltoid regions have distinguishable principal shoulder actions.
records.limitations: Anatomical actions do not rank exercises or quantify regional hypertrophy.

records.title_en: Rotator cuff anatomy is not a rehabilitation prescription
records.title_zh: 肩袖解剖知识不等于康复处方
records.population: Foundational shoulder anatomy; research-only clinical boundary.
records.summary_zh: 肩袖由冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌组成，参与肩关节稳定、外旋、内旋和外展等任务。知道这些结构不能用于诊断肩痛，也不能自动生成外旋康复训练。
records.technical_summary_en: Rotator-cuff muscles contribute to glenohumeral stability and distinct rotation or abduction tasks.
records.limitations: Research summary only; no diagnosis, rehabilitation, clearance or personal exercise recommendation.

records.title_en: Elbow flexion involves more than the biceps
records.title_zh: 肘屈并不只有肱二头肌参与
records.population: Foundational upper-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 肱二头肌、肱肌和肱桡肌都参与肘屈。肱二头肌还参与前臂旋后并跨过肩关节，肱桡肌在中立握位下常有明显作用，但握法不构成完全隔离。
records.technical_summary_en: Elbow flexion is shared across biceps brachii, brachialis and brachioradialis with position-dependent roles.
records.limitations: No grip-specific activation or hypertrophy percentage is inferred.

records.title_en: The triceps long head crosses the shoulder and elbow
records.title_zh: 肱三头肌长头跨越肩与肘两个关节
records.population: Foundational upper-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 肱三头肌三头共同参与肘伸，其中长头还跨过肩关节。过顶与非过顶臂屈伸因此具有不同的肌长条件，但解剖结构本身不能保证某个变式带来更大局部增肌。
records.technical_summary_en: The triceps long head is biarticular and changes length across shoulder position.
records.limitations: Head-specific hypertrophy requires longitudinal exercise evidence, not anatomy alone.

records.title_en: Wrist flexion, extension and grip are different tasks
records.title_zh: 腕屈、腕伸与握持是不同任务
records.population: Foundational upper-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 前臂包含多条腕指屈肌和伸肌。腕弯举、反向腕弯举和负重握持表达不同任务，握力成绩不能直接替代前臂肌肥大测量。
records.technical_summary_en: Forearm training tasks should distinguish wrist flexion, wrist extension, finger action and gripping demands.
records.limitations: The current catalogue does not comprehensively cover finger and grip-device exercise families.

records.title_en: The abdominal wall has distinct motion and pressure roles
records.title_zh: 腹壁肌群同时承担运动与压力管理
records.population: Foundational trunk anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 腹直肌主要参与躯干屈曲，腹内外斜肌参与旋转和侧屈，腹横肌更多参与腹腔压缩与稳定。卷腹、抗旋转和抗伸展因此不应被视为完全相同的核心动作。
records.technical_summary_en: Rectus abdominis, obliques and transversus abdominis have distinguishable trunk-motion and pressure roles.
records.limitations: No spot-reduction, spinal-protection or pain-treatment claim is supported.

records.title_en: Spinal extensors can move or stabilize the trunk
records.title_zh: 脊柱伸肌既可以产生运动，也可以维持稳定
records.population: Foundational trunk and back anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 竖脊肌群可参与脊柱伸展和侧屈，也会在髋铰链等动作中维持躯干位置；腰方肌参与侧屈和骨盆控制。动作参与不等于腰痛原因或康复方向。
records.technical_summary_en: Back and posterior-abdominal muscles can act dynamically or isometrically depending on the task.
records.limitations: No back-pain diagnosis, weakness assessment or rehabilitation advice is provided.

records.title_en: Rectus femoris differs from the three vasti
records.title_zh: 股直肌与三块股肌的跨关节关系不同
records.population: Foundational lower-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 股四头肌都参与膝伸，但股直肌还跨过髋关节并参与髋屈；股外侧肌、股内侧肌和股中间肌只跨膝。髋位因此是解释腿屈伸与蹲类差异时的重要条件。
records.technical_summary_en: Rectus femoris is biarticular, while the vasti cross the knee only.
records.limitations: Foot angle, stance or exercise name does not prove selective vastus hypertrophy.

records.title_en: Hamstring anatomy explains the need for two movement families
records.title_zh: 腘绳肌解剖解释了为什么要区分髋铰链与屈膝
records.population: Foundational lower-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 多数腘绳肌跨越髋和膝，参与髋伸与屈膝；股二头肌短头例外，只跨膝。髋铰链和腿弯举因此表达不同任务，但解剖结构不能单独决定两类动作的剂量。
records.technical_summary_en: Most hamstrings are biarticular and contribute to both hip extension and knee flexion; biceps-femoris short head is an exception.
records.limitations: Regional hypertrophy and exercise superiority require longitudinal evidence.

records.title_en: The gluteal group combines extension, abduction and pelvic control
records.title_zh: 臀肌群包含髋伸、外展与骨盆控制任务
records.population: Foundational lower-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 臀大肌主要参与髋伸和外旋，臀中肌与臀小肌更多参与髋外展和单腿支撑中的骨盆控制。因此练臀不应被压缩成单一臀桥或单一外展动作。
records.technical_summary_en: Gluteus maximus, medius and minimus contribute to distinct but overlapping hip tasks.
records.limitations: No movement is ranked as the best glute exercise and single-leg form is not a clinical screen.

records.title_en: Hip adduction and abduction are opposite but coordinated tasks
records.title_zh: 髋内收与外展是相反但协同的任务
records.population: Foundational lower-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 内收长肌、短肌和大肌等参与髋内收，臀中肌和臀小肌等参与外展与骨盆控制。两类动作要分别记录，不能把一个‘髋稳定’标签当作临床结论。
records.technical_summary_en: Adductor and abductor groups perform opposite frontal-plane actions while contributing to broader hip control.
records.limitations: No groin, hip-stability or rehabilitation assessment is provided.

records.title_en: Gastrocnemius and soleus differ in joint crossing
records.title_zh: 腓肠肌与比目鱼肌的跨关节关系不同
records.population: Foundational lower-limb anatomy; educational use only.
records.summary_zh: 腓肠肌跨越膝和踝，比目鱼肌只跨踝。膝关节位置会改变腓肠肌长度，因此站姿与坐姿提踵条件不同，但任何一种都不能被称为完全隔离。
records.technical_summary_en: Gastrocnemius is biarticular while soleus crosses the ankle only, making knee position relevant to interpretation.
records.limitations: Anatomy does not establish an optimal calf exercise or personal range of motion.
